head: claude/mi159-one-live-workplan
title: MI-159: exactly one live work plan, a corrected roadmap, and TASK-level priority
body:
Tier-1 throughout — documentation plus one CI guard. No `config/`, no `src/runtime/`, no order path, no strategy parameter. Landing declared self (`.github/pr-landing/mi159-one-live-workplan.json`) and armed (`.github/pr-automerge-requests/mi159-one-live-workplan.txt`); `check_pr_landing.py --base origin/main` reads `OK — state=declared_self_land`.

⚠️ The work object `WO-20260907-ONE-LIVE-WORK-PLAN-A-ROADMAP-THAT` is **not on `origin/main`** — `git cat-file -e` fails on it. Already filed; this session worked from the dispatch brief and did not re-diagnose it.

---

## 1. Exactly one live work plan

**The live plan is [`docs/claude/WORKPLAN-2026-08-29.md`](docs/claude/WORKPLAN-2026-08-29.md)**, established by reading the documents rather than by inheriting the claim: 08-29 says it supersedes 08-26; 08-26 says it replaces 08-21; nothing in the repo claims to supersede 08-29; and `WORKPLAN-NIGHT-2026-08-29` states in its own header that it is subordinate and *"does not supersede it"*.

**Three corrections to the dispatch brief, all verified:**

1. **The census is THIRTEEN, not twelve.** Population: `git ls-files | grep -iE "workplan|work-plan"` = 24 paths, minus 10 `docs/sprint-logs/`, minus 1 `.claude/skills/` = 13. Both `docs/workplan.md` *and* `docs/claude/workplan.md` exist — different files, 211 and 981 lines. Earlier counts saw one.

2. **TWO documents declared themselves live, not one.** `WORKPLAN-2026-08-14.md` (`Status: ACTIVE` — the one that misled the manager) **and** `POST-VALUE-PIVOT-WORKPLAN-2026-07-27.md`, which was in no brief. So the guard had a **real** positive on the day it was written, independent of its plants.

3. **The asserted chain `08-14 → 08-21` is not written anywhere.** `WORKPLAN-2026-08-21.md` contains **zero** occurrences of `08-14`. The documented chain is `08-21 → 08-26 → 08-29` only. **That gap is the whole incident**: the successor took over without naming what it replaced, so 08-14 was left declaring `ACTIVE` with nothing pointing away from it, for 24 days.

All 13 documents now carry an explicit `PLAN STATUS` header — visible markdown, not a comment, because a reader who opens one file alone must not be misled.

**`closed_unfinished` stays distinguishable from `superseded`, and the guard enforces it.** R4 fails a `closed_unfinished` plan that does not say what was left. Where the residual was verified, it is named:

- **`WORKPLAN-2026-08-14.md` → Lane 0 only.** Lanes 1–3 delivered; Lanes 4–5 were planning errors (already shipped when the plan was written — the defect `BL-20260814-ROADMAP-QUEUED-LISTS-CONTRADICT-SHIPPED-LINES` records).
- **`POST-VALUE-PIVOT-2026-07-27` → both tracks**, Track 2 blocked on its single stated operator hand-off (Schwab keys).

Where it was **not** audited, the header says so. *"We did not look"* is an accepted answer; silence is not.

### The detector

`scripts/ci/check_one_live_workplan.py` — six rules, **12 planted controls**, registered in `run_guards.GUARDS` (ungated: the failure is a doc going stale while nothing touches it, which a diff-scoped guard cannot see) and in `guard_selftests.COVERED_BY_CHECKER`, which `check_selftest_wiring.py` verifies rather than trusts.

- **R1** exactly one `live` — **and zero is a separate failure**, not folded in.
- **R2** every discovered plan declares a status. A *new* plan document fails until it does, which is what makes discovery-by-rule load-bearing rather than a hand-maintained list.
- **R3** `superseded` names a successor that exists.
- **R4** `closed_unfinished` carries a substantive residual — **the rule that stops the two terminal states collapsing**.
- **R5** closed vocabulary; a plausible typo (`closed-unfinished`) gets the R5 message, not a confusing "no status".
- **R6** a terminal plan must not still carry a legacy `**Status:** ACTIVE` line. The struck-through form is deliberately accepted so the record survives.

**Proven on a real positive, not only on plants:** the guard **failed on the real tree** before the headers were applied (13 × R2). It passes now. Its **negative control runs first** and caught a staging bug in my own fixtures on the day it was written; two further controls assert the *honest* answers pass (an unaudited residual, a struck-through `ACTIVE`).

## 2. `ROADMAP.md` matches reality — or says it was not checked

- **§ "Next" repointed** from the stale 08-14 plan to the live plan and the task ranking. It also now records that `CYCLE-PRIORITY.json` is **newer than every work plan** and sits above them.
- **M15 corrected — 71 days stale, in the dangerous direction.** Its newest dated claim was 2026-06-28, so it read as though Alpaca real money was not routed. The field (`config/accounts.yaml`) says `alpaca_live` is `mode: live` / `real_money` / `strategies: ['tlt_pullback_1h']`, with the T+1 gate armed in front of it — and `MI-140` records that the leg **cannot place an order**.
- **M20 corrected — 13 days stale**, missing the entire 2026-09-06→07 exit-mechanics thread: **25 of 44** enabled+live legs have no reachable take-profit; **all 44** grade `insufficient_n` on exit-location fidelity (max live n **8** vs a floor of **30** — a *data-volume* result, so lowering the bar does not rescue it); **0 of 44** had a backtest read and dispositioned before going live.
- **The other 31 rows are marked `UNVERIFIED`.** Not guessed at, not left blank. Measured across all 33 rows: **18** carry a newest internal date ≥30 days old (median 42), **4** carry no date at all. Staleness is explicitly *not* treated as inaccuracy — it is stated as a triage signal that produced both corrections and some false leads.
- This partly **corrects the live plan's own Lane S3** (*"M6/M9/M10 carry no date at all"*): M9 does carry one; the undated set is M0–M5, M6, M10, M17.

⚠️ **`BL-20260814-ROADMAP-QUEUED-LISTS-CONTRADICT-SHIPPED-LINES` cannot be closed.** Both instances it names are **still present** — M30's *"Queued loose-ends"* and M29's *"P1b remaining"*. I did not fix them, so it stays open.

## 3. TASK-level priority that crosses milestones

[`docs/claude/TASK-PRIORITY-2026-09-07.md`](docs/claude/TASK-PRIORITY-2026-09-07.md) ranks **16 tasks**, anchored to `CY-20260906-TRADING-TRUTH` (which stands — re-affirmed by the operator). Each names its parent milestone, what it unblocks, and why it sits where it does. The ranking criteria are stated so the order is arguable rather than asserted.

**It reaches into four tracks we are not funding** — M31 (extend the reachability guard to the *venue* clamp: the nearest existing capability to what MI-146 found, and rebuilding it inside M20 would be the built-a-mechanism-that-already-existed anti-pattern), M24, M40, M15 — and records **M21 as a null result**: looked at, nothing this cycle needs, which is a different statement from *we did not look*.

**It recommends closing, pruning or consolidating no milestone**, and says so explicitly so a future revision does not.

### It also corrects the standing diagnosis of the performance contradiction

Verified live this session (`GET /api/bot/performance`, HTTP 200). **Stating the population:** the contradiction is in the **`paper` sub-block (n=872)** — `totalPnl` **+$120,790.89** against `expectancyR` **−0.1341**. The top-level real-money block (n=424) reads −69.53 and −0.3153, **consistent in sign, no contradiction there at all**.

The named cause is R contamination (`MI-30`, `MI-144`). The field says otherwise:

| | |
|---|---|
| `rBasis.refusedWrongSide` | **0** |
| R contaminated | 91/872 = **10.4%**, at `rCoverage` **1.0** |
| `pnlCoverage` | **0.2041** — 79.6% of PnL not measured |
| **`ict_scalp_mgc_15m`** | **6 trades**, **+$231,532** — **192% of the entire headline**, on an ordinary +2.16R |

**`expectancyR` is the sounder of the two instruments, and the gates read it. The DOLLAR figure is the broken one** — 20.4% measured, dominated by a futures multiplier on six rows. Same class `CLAUDE.md` already documents for the +$284k orphaned `ib_paper` rows. Ranking this as an R defect would have pointed a session at the instrument that works.

⚠️ This does **not** refute `MI-30`: its 17.2% is a claim over *all closed rows*, a different population I did not reproduce. It stays open on its own terms.

This PR was opened via `pr-opener.yml` for the same 403, with the request also placed on that separate branch.
